# Feats #352 portable review fixtures

These are the exact 100 candidates from feats batch 19, pf1-content 11.4.0 at
`02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d`, with the system v11.11 manifest.
Every copied upstream file is byte exact. Empty manifest pack directories use
`.gitkeep`; the selected import does not pretend to include unrelated lookup
inputs. `preview.json` freezes complete-source prerequisite facts explicitly.

The owning review is [feats-352.json](../../../scripts/catalog/legal/feats-352.json).
`provenance.json` pins ordered identities and source bytes; comparison files pin
literal PCGen rows and publication declarations. Supporting source files separate
complete governing rules, partial pointers, prerequisite comparisons and audit-only
examples/counters. Publication anchors establish neither a whole-body comparison
nor a complete inherited notice chain. No Archives of Nethys or book PDF was used.

`original-identities.json` protects every prior fixture/inventory and every raw
shared value, including whitespace. `protected-context.json` records the union of
all earlier complete contexts, held dependencies included, before adding optional
Notes. The standalone proof verifies complete selected/full ordinary/draft outputs,
all 538 resources, original reconstruction, all prior bindings and admitted
closures; `verification.json`, `local-binding-proof.json` and
`historical-binding-proof.json` record its final completed scope.

The three CRB Skill Focus variants are admitted for Survival, Ride and Swim.
Their automatic rank expressions remain unsupported. Local Situations let a
player select the published +3/+6 value; tests do not claim automatic threshold
execution. All other feats retain named attribution holds, independently of
outstanding calculations. Character-scoped held examples exercise the public
preview without permitting new global admission. `release.json` is an isolated
three-admission transport, never a deployment or production release.
